A Heart-Healthy Recipe from the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute Prep time: 45 minutes Cook time: 25 minutes Total time: 70 minutes Number of Servings: 6 Vinegar and garlic give this easy-to-make dish its tasty zip. Ingredients 1 and 1/2 lb lean sirloin steak 2 tsp vegetable oil 1 clove garlic, minced 1 tsp vinegar 1/8 tsp salt 1/8 tsp ground black pepper 2 large onions, sliced 1 large tomato, sliced 3 cups boiled potatoes, diced Directions Trim fat from steak and cut it into small, thin pieces. In a large skillet, heat oil and sauté garlic until garlic is golden. Add steak, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Cook for 6 minutes, stirring beef until brown. Add onion and tomato. Cook until onion is transparent. Serve with boiled potatoes.
